title: What the tests written by D1 (one module) or by the integration-test operation (the whole plan) are for. Code runs them on the pinned baseline and checks each against its kind; see agents/pipeline-build-agent.md.

manifest_hash.description: Copied from the pinned context manifest.

module_id.description: The module under test. Present for scope `module`, absent for `integration`.

test_id.description: The test as the runner names it (for example tests/generated/test_x.py::TestX::test_y).

path.description: Repository-relative, forward slashes: where the test sits in the tree. The generated_tests write root mirrors the repository, so the file is generated_tests/<path>.

kind.description: `new_behavior` must fail on the pinned baseline, by assertion; `regression` must pass on it.

expected_failure.description: Why a `new_behavior` test fails on the baseline: the behaviour that is missing.
